def _build_deps() -> Any:
    from mem_mcp.audit.logger import NoopAuditLogger
    from mem_mcp.mcp.tools._deps import NoopQuotas, ToolDeps

    class _StubEmbed:
        async def embed(self, content: str) -> Any:
            from mem_mcp.embeddings.bedrock import EmbedResult

            return EmbedResult(vector=[0.0] * 1024, input_tokens=max(1, len(content) // 4))

    return ToolDeps(embeddings=_StubEmbed(), audit=NoopAuditLogger(), quotas=NoopQuotas())


async def _setup(conn: asyncpg.Connection) -> dict[str, Any]:
    tenant_a = await conn.fetchval(
        "INSERT INTO tenants (email) VALUES ($1) RETURNING id",
        f"wf-a-{uuid4()}@example.test",
    )
    tenant_b = await conn.fetchval(
        "INSERT INTO tenants (email) VALUES ($1) RETURNING id",
        f"wf-b-{uuid4()}@example.test",
    )
    team = await conn.fetchval(
        "INSERT INTO teams (name, created_by_tenant_id) VALUES ($1, $2) RETURNING id",
        f"wf-team-{uuid4().hex[:8]}",
        tenant_a,
    )
    await conn.execute(
        """
        INSERT INTO team_role_assignments (parent_team_id, member_kind, member_id, role_id, status, assigned_by_user_id)
        SELECT $1, 'user', $2, (SELECT id FROM roles_catalog WHERE role_key = 'owner' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1), 'active', $2
        """,
        team,
        tenant_a,
    )
    await conn.execute(
        """
        INSERT INTO team_role_assignments (parent_team_id, member_kind, member_id, role_id, status, assigned_by_user_id)
        SELECT $1, 'user', $2, (SELECT id FROM roles_catalog WHERE role_key = 'member' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1), 'active', $2
        """,
        team,
        tenant_b,
    )
    for t, sub in ((tenant_a, f"sub-wf-a-{uuid4()}"), (tenant_b, f"sub-wf-b-{uuid4()}")):
        await conn.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO tenant_identities
                (tenant_id, cognito_sub, provider, email, is_primary, default_team_id)
            VALUES ($1, $2, 'cognito', $3, true, $4)
            """,
            t,
            sub,
            f"{t}@example.test",
            team,
        )
    client_id = f"client:wf-{uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    await conn.execute(
        """
        INSERT INTO oauth_clients (id, redirect_uris, scope, registration_payload, review_status)
        VALUES ($1, ARRAY[]::text[], 'memory.read memory.write', '{}'::jsonb, 'auto_allowed')
        """,
        client_id,
    )
    return {"tenant_a": tenant_a, "tenant_b": tenant_b, "team": team, "client_id": client_id}


async def _cleanup(pool: Any, tenant_a: UUID, tenant_b: UUID, team: UUID, client_id: str) -> None:
    tenants = [tenant_a, tenant_b]
    async with pool.acquire() as conn:
        async with conn.transaction():
            await conn.execute(
                "DELETE FROM memory_references WHERE source_memory_id IN (SELECT id FROM memories WHERE tenant_id = ANY($1::uuid[])) OR target_memory_id IN (SELECT id FROM memories WHERE tenant_id = ANY($1::uuid[]))",
                tenants,
            )
            await conn.execute("DELETE FROM memory_map_events WHERE tenant_id = ANY($1::uuid[])", tenants)
            await conn.execute("DELETE FROM memory_map_membership WHERE tenant_id = ANY($1::uuid[])", tenants)
            await conn.execute("DELETE FROM work_items WHERE tenant_id = ANY($1::uuid[])", tenants)
            await conn.execute("DELETE FROM work_item_history WHERE tenant_id = ANY($1::uuid[])", tenants)
            await conn.execute("DELETE FROM workflow_signoffs WHERE tenant_id = ANY($1::uuid[])", tenants)
            await conn.execute("DELETE FROM workflow_signoff_requests WHERE tenant_id = ANY($1::uuid[])", tenants)
            await conn.execute("DELETE FROM workflow_transitions WHERE tenant_id = ANY($1::uuid[])", tenants)
            await conn.execute("DELETE FROM workflow_stages WHERE tenant_id = ANY($1::uuid[])", tenants)
            await conn.execute("DELETE FROM team_workflows WHERE tenant_id = ANY($1::uuid[])", tenants)
            await conn.execute("DELETE FROM memory_maps WHERE tenant_id = ANY($1::uuid[])", tenants)
            await conn.execute("DELETE FROM slugs WHERE team_id = $1", team)
            await conn.execute("DELETE FROM memories WHERE tenant_id = ANY($1::uuid[])", tenants)
            await conn.execute("DELETE FROM team_role_assignments WHERE parent_team_id = $1", team)
            await conn.execute("DELETE FROM tenant_identities WHERE tenant_id = ANY($1::uuid[])", tenants)
            await conn.execute("DELETE FROM teams WHERE id = $1", team)
            await conn.execute("DELETE FROM tenants WHERE id = ANY($1::uuid[])", tenants)
            await conn.execute("DELETE FROM oauth_clients WHERE id = $1", client_id)


def _ctx(pool: Any, tenant: UUID, client_id: str) -> ToolContext:
    return ToolContext(
        request_id=f"req-{uuid4().hex[:8]}",
        tenant_id=tenant,
        identity_id=tenant,
        client_id=client_id,
        scopes=frozenset({"memory.read", "memory.write"}),
        db_pool=pool,
        deps=_build_deps(),
    )

async def test_workflow_define_propose_sign_commit(pg_pool: Any) -> None:
    async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
        async with conn.transaction():
            s = await _setup(conn)
    tenant_a, tenant_b, team, client_id = s["tenant_a"], s["tenant_b"], s["team"], s["client_id"]
    ctx_a = _ctx(pg_pool, tenant_a, client_id)
    ctx_b = _ctx(pg_pool, tenant_b, client_id)

    try:
        opened = await MindmapOpenTool()(ctx_a, MindmapOpenInput(title="WF", root_question="Q?"))
        map_key = opened.map_key
        from mem_mcp.mcp.tools.mindmap_write_node import MindmapWriteNodeInput, MindmapWriteNodeTool

        node = await MindmapWriteNodeTool()(ctx_a, MindmapWriteNodeInput(map_key=map_key, content="Task", node_role="position"))
        node_id = node.node_id
        await MindmapWorkMarkTool()(ctx_a, MindmapWorkMarkInput(map_key=map_key, node_id=node_id, kind="story"))

        # create workflow
        wf = await MindmapWorkflowCreateTool()(
            ctx_a,
            MindmapWorkflowCreateInput(
                name="flow",
                stages=[
                    {"name": "todo", "ordinal": 0, "is_initial": True},
                    {"name": "review", "ordinal": 1},
                    {"name": "done", "ordinal": 2, "is_terminal": True},
                ],
                transitions=[
                    {"from_stage": "todo", "to_stage": "review", "requires_signoff": True, "signoff_min": 1},
                    {"from_stage": "review", "to_stage": "done"},
                ],
            ),
        )
        wf_id = wf.workflow_id
        from mem_mcp.mcp.tools.mindmap_workflow_activate import MindmapWorkflowActivateInput, MindmapWorkflowActivateTool

        await MindmapWorkflowActivateTool()(ctx_a, MindmapWorkflowActivateInput(workflow_id=wf_id))

        # make item workflow-backed
        async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
            await conn.execute(
                "UPDATE work_items SET workflow_id = $1, current_stage = 'todo' WHERE memory_id = $2 AND tenant_id = $3",
                wf_id,
                node_id,
                tenant_a,
            )

        # propose signoff-gated move
        prop = await MindmapWorkflowProposeMoveTool()(
            ctx_a,
            MindmapWorkflowProposeMoveInput(map_key=map_key, node_id=node_id, to_stage="review"),
        )
        assert prop.awaiting_signoff is True
        assert prop.request_id is not None
        assert prop.current_stage == "todo"
        # DB request pending
        async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
            st = await conn.fetchval(
                "SELECT status FROM workflow_signoff_requests WHERE request_id = $1", prop.request_id
            )
        assert st == "pending"

        # signoff by eligible signatory (tenant_b) - may fail due to RLS; attempt
        try:
            sig = await MindmapWorkflowSignoffTool()(
                ctx_b,
                MindmapWorkflowSignoffInput(request_id=prop.request_id),
            )
            assert sig.committed is True
            async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
                cs = await conn.fetchval("SELECT current_stage FROM work_items WHERE memory_id = $1", node_id)
            assert cs == "review"
            rstatus = await conn.fetchval(
                "SELECT status FROM workflow_signoff_requests WHERE request_id = $1", prop.request_id
            )
            assert rstatus == "committed"
        except JsonRpcError as e:
            # record but continue
            print("signoff failed:", e.code, e.data)

        # no-signoff move commits immediately
        # move todo? already review; propose review->done (no signoff)
        prop2 = await MindmapWorkflowProposeMoveTool()(
            ctx_a,
            MindmapWorkflowProposeMoveInput(map_key=map_key, node_id=node_id, to_stage="done"),
        )
        assert prop2.awaiting_signoff is False
        async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
            cnt = await conn.fetchval(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workflow_signoff_requests WHERE work_item_memory_id = $1", node_id
            )
            # at least no new pending; history stage row
            pass

        # set_status gate
        # reset to todo item with workflow_id
        async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
            await conn.execute(
                "UPDATE work_items SET workflow_id = $1, current_stage = 'todo' WHERE memory_id = $2",
                wf_id,
                node_id,
            )
        try:
            await MindmapWorkSetStatusTool()(
                ctx_a,
                MindmapWorkSetStatusInput(map_key=map_key, node_id=node_id, status="review"),
            )
            raise AssertionError("expected move_blocked")
        except JsonRpcError as e:
            assert e.code == -32602
            assert e.data is not None and e.data.get("code") == "move_blocked"

        # blocked reason via work_list
        wl = await MindmapWorkListTool()(ctx_a, MindmapWorkListInput(map_key=map_key))
        assert len(wl.items) >= 1

        # remap unmapped
        await MindmapWorkflowRemapTool()(
            ctx_a,
            MindmapWorkflowRemapInput(map_key=map_key, mappings={"todo": "todo"}),
        )

        # pending signoffs read
        ps = await MindmapWorkflowPendingSignoffsTool()(ctx_b, MindmapWorkflowPendingSignoffsInput())
        assert isinstance(ps, list)

    finally:
        await _cleanup(pg_pool, tenant_a, tenant_b, team, client_id)

async def test_signoff_exclusion_owner_keeps_pending(pg_pool: Any) -> None:
    async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
        async with conn.transaction():
            s = await _setup(conn)
    tenant_a, tenant_b, team, client_id = s["tenant_a"], s["tenant_b"], s["team"], s["client_id"]
    ctx_a = _ctx(pg_pool, tenant_a, client_id)
    try:
        opened = await MindmapOpenTool()(ctx_a, MindmapOpenInput(title="WF2", root_question="Q?"))
        map_key = opened.map_key
        from mem_mcp.mcp.tools.mindmap_write_node import MindmapWriteNodeInput, MindmapWriteNodeTool

        node = await MindmapWriteNodeTool()(ctx_a, MindmapWriteNodeInput(map_key=map_key, content="Task", node_role="position"))
        node_id = node.node_id
        await MindmapWorkMarkTool()(ctx_a, MindmapWorkMarkInput(map_key=map_key, node_id=node_id, kind="story"))

        wf = await MindmapWorkflowCreateTool()(
            ctx_a,
            MindmapWorkflowCreateInput(
                name="flow2",
                stages=[
                    {"name": "todo", "ordinal": 0, "is_initial": True},
                    {"name": "review", "ordinal": 1},
                ],
                transitions=[
                    {"from_stage": "todo", "to_stage": "review", "requires_signoff": True, "signoff_min": 1},
                ],
            ),
        )
        from mem_mcp.mcp.tools.mindmap_workflow_activate import MindmapWorkflowActivateInput, MindmapWorkflowActivateTool

        await MindmapWorkflowActivateTool()(ctx_a, MindmapWorkflowActivateInput(workflow_id=wf.workflow_id))
        async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
            await conn.execute(
                "UPDATE work_items SET workflow_id = $1, current_stage = 'todo' WHERE memory_id = $2",
                wf.workflow_id,
                node_id,
            )
        prop = await MindmapWorkflowProposeMoveTool()(
            ctx_a,
            MindmapWorkflowProposeMoveInput(map_key=map_key, node_id=node_id, to_stage="review"),
        )
        # owner signs -> should not count (stays pending)
        try:
            await MindmapWorkflowSignoffTool()(
                ctx_a,
                MindmapWorkflowSignoffInput(request_id=prop.request_id),
            )
        except JsonRpcError:
            pass
        async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
            st = await conn.fetchval(
                "SELECT status FROM workflow_signoff_requests WHERE request_id = $1", prop.request_id
            )
        assert st == "pending"
        cs = await conn.fetchval("SELECT current_stage FROM work_items WHERE memory_id = $1", node_id)
        assert cs == "todo"
    finally:
        await _cleanup(pg_pool, tenant_a, tenant_b, team, client_id)

async def test_role_restricted_signer_rejected(pg_pool: Any) -> None:
    async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
        async with conn.transaction():
            s = await _setup(conn)
    tenant_a, tenant_b, team, client_id = s["tenant_a"], s["tenant_b"], s["team"], s["client_id"]
    ctx_a = _ctx(pg_pool, tenant_a, client_id)
    ctx_b = _ctx(pg_pool, tenant_b, client_id)
    try:
        opened = await MindmapOpenTool()(ctx_a, MindmapOpenInput(title="WF3", root_question="Q?"))
        map_key = opened.map_key
        from mem_mcp.mcp.tools.mindmap_write_node import MindmapWriteNodeInput, MindmapWriteNodeTool

        node = await MindmapWriteNodeTool()(ctx_a, MindmapWriteNodeInput(map_key=map_key, content="Task", node_role="position"))
        node_id = node.node_id
        await MindmapWorkMarkTool()(ctx_a, MindmapWorkMarkInput(map_key=map_key, node_id=node_id, kind="story"))

        wf = await MindmapWorkflowCreateTool()(
            ctx_a,
            MindmapWorkflowCreateInput(
                name="flow3",
                stages=[
                    {"name": "todo", "ordinal": 0, "is_initial": True},
                    {"name": "review", "ordinal": 1},
                ],
                transitions=[
                    {
                        "from_stage": "todo",
                        "to_stage": "review",
                        "requires_signoff": True,
                        "signoff_min": 1,
                        "signoff_roles": ["admin"],
                    },
                ],
            ),
        )
        from mem_mcp.mcp.tools.mindmap_workflow_activate import MindmapWorkflowActivateInput, MindmapWorkflowActivateTool

        await MindmapWorkflowActivateTool()(ctx_a, MindmapWorkflowActivateInput(workflow_id=wf.workflow_id))
        async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
            await conn.execute(
                "UPDATE work_items SET workflow_id = $1, current_stage = 'todo' WHERE memory_id = $2",
                wf.workflow_id,
                node_id,
            )
        prop = await MindmapWorkflowProposeMoveTool()(
            ctx_a,
            MindmapWorkflowProposeMoveInput(map_key=map_key, node_id=node_id, to_stage="review"),
        )
        # tenant_b is member, not admin -> rejected
        with pytest.raises(JsonRpcError) as exc:
            await MindmapWorkflowSignoffTool()(
                ctx_b,
                MindmapWorkflowSignoffInput(request_id=prop.request_id),
            )
        assert exc.value.code == -32602
        assert exc.value.data is not None
        assert exc.value.data.get("code") in ("not_eligible", "not_pending", None) or "not_eligible" in str(exc.value.data)
    finally:
        await _cleanup(pg_pool, tenant_a, tenant_b, team, client_id)

        await MindmapWorkMarkTool()(ctx_a, MindmapWorkMarkInput(map_key=map_key, node_id=node_id, kind="story"))

        wf = await MindmapWorkflowCreateTool()(
            ctx_a,
            MindmapWorkflowCreateInput(
                name="flow",
                stages=[
                    {"name": "todo", "ordinal": 0, "is_initial": True},
                    {"name": "review", "ordinal": 1},
                    {"name": "done", "ordinal": 2, "is_terminal": True},
                ],
                transitions=[
                    {"from_stage": "todo", "to_stage": "review", "requires_signoff": True, "signoff_min": 1},
                    {"from_stage": "review", "to_stage": "done"},
                ],
            ),
        )
        wf_id = wf.workflow_id
        from mem_mcp.mcp.tools.mindmap_workflow_activate import MindmapWorkflowActivateInput, MindmapWorkflowActivateTool

        await MindmapWorkflowActivateTool()(ctx_a, MindmapWorkflowActivateInput(workflow_id=wf_id))

        async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
            await conn.execute(
                "UPDATE work_items SET workflow_id = $1, current_stage = 'todo' WHERE memory_id = $2 AND tenant_id = $3",
                wf_id,
                node_id,
                tenant_a,
            )

        prop = await MindmapWorkflowProposeMoveTool()(
            ctx_a,
            MindmapWorkflowProposeMoveInput(map_key=map_key, node_id=node_id, to_stage="review"),
        )
        assert prop.awaiting_signoff is True
        assert prop.request_id is not None
        assert prop.current_stage == "todo"

        async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
            st = await conn.fetchval(
                "SELECT status FROM workflow_signoff_requests WHERE request_id = $1", prop.request_id
            )
        assert st == "pending"

        # signoff by tenant_b
        sig = await MindmapWorkflowSignoffTool()(
            ctx_b,
            MindmapWorkflowSignoffInput(request_id=prop.request_id),
        )
        assert sig.committed is True
        async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
            cs = await conn.fetchval("SELECT current_stage FROM work_items WHERE memory_id = $1", node_id)
        assert cs == "review"
        rstatus = await conn.fetchval(
            "SELECT status FROM workflow_signoff_requests WHERE request_id = $1", prop.request_id
        )
        assert rstatus == "committed"

        # no-signoff move commits immediately
        prop2 = await MindmapWorkflowProposeMoveTool()(
            ctx_a,
            MindmapWorkflowProposeMoveInput(map_key=map_key, node_id=node_id, to_stage="done"),
        )
        assert prop2.awaiting_signoff is False

        # set_status gate
        async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
            await conn.execute(
                "UPDATE work_items SET workflow_id = $1, current_stage = 'todo' WHERE memory_id = $2",
                wf_id,
                node_id,
            )
        try:
            await MindmapWorkSetStatusTool()(
                ctx_a,
                MindmapWorkSetStatusInput(map_key=map_key, node_id=node_id, status="review"),
            )
            raise AssertionError("expected move_blocked")
        except JsonRpcError as e:
            assert e.code == -32602
            assert e.data is not None and e.data.get("code") == "move_blocked"

        wl = await MindmapWorkListTool()(ctx_a, MindmapWorkListInput(map_key=map_key))
        assert len(wl.items) >= 1

        await MindmapWorkflowRemapTool()(
            ctx_a,
            MindmapWorkflowRemapInput(map_key=map_key, mappings={"todo": "todo"}),
        )

        ps = await MindmapWorkflowPendingSignoffsTool()(ctx_b, MindmapWorkflowPendingSignoffsInput())
        assert isinstance(ps, list)

    finally:
        await _cleanup(pg_pool, tenant_a, tenant_b, team, client_id)
